Plexor is a control plane (`Plexor.Host`) on ASP.NET Core, plus a lightweight NodeAgent on every compute node. No managed services in between: NATS for the event bus, PostgreSQL for state, Ceph or MinIO for object storage. Not an OpenStack-grade microservice zoo, not SaaS with a forced control plane — infrastructure that runs on your hardware, on your terms.

## What's inside the binary

<ArchitectureDiagram />

Plexor.Host exposes REST + gRPC, registers modules via DI composition, emits `artifacts/openapi.json` on every build. Every module — Tenants, Identity, Compute, Network, Storage, Billing, Telemetry, Marketplace — boots inside the same process. Audit, Telemetry and Network are extraction-ready: if measured load demands it, they split into their own service as a deploy change, not a code refactor.

## Providers directory

<ProvidersDirectory locale="en" />

Install providers are picked once at `plx init` via system probes. App providers ship as YAML manifests — community can publish their own, operators install with `plx provider install <git-url>`. No NuGet plugins, no Helm charts.
